title: Goal
description: What a simulated user, or an explorer, tries to achieve, and how success is decided.

reach_state.label: Reach a state
reach_state.description: Get the app into a target state, such as a confirmed request.

extract_fact.label: Extract a fact
extract_fact.description: Get the assistant to state one specific fact.

attempt_forbidden.label: Attempt something forbidden
attempt_forbidden.description: Try an action this role must not be allowed to do.

complete_flow.label: Complete a flow
complete_flow.description: Finish a multi-step flow from the first step to the last.

statement.description: The goal in the user's own words. The simulated user works toward it.

role.description: The app role the user signs in as. Leave empty to pick it when starting a run.

success_criteria.description: Each entry starts with db:, tool:, text: (decided by code) or judge: (decided by the judge). No prefix means judge:.
